title: Ablaze Venezuelan Perilla Seed Salad
description: A charred, shattering salad perfect for date nights, featuring perilla seed deulkkae simmered with smoky spices and fresh lime for a low-carb twist.
instructions: Heat a non-stick skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the olive oil and let it swirl around the pan.
Spread the fresh perilla seeds across the skillet and let them char until they crackle, about 2 minutes.
Remove the seeds and set them aside to cool slightly.
In the same skillet, add the sliced bell pepper and sauté until just tender, about 3 minutes.
Stir in the smoked paprika, cumin, and sea salt, cooking for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Return the perilla seeds to the skillet and toss to coat with the spices.
Squeeze the lime juice over the mixture and stir to combine.
Transfer the salad to a serving bowl, top with diced avocado and chopped cilantro, and serve immediately.
